name: Wordnik
tagline: Large English word corpus with definitions, examples, and related words.
description: Wordnik provides a public API over a large English word corpus including definitions, example sentences, related words, pronunciations, and audio. Developers can look up words, explore word relationships, and power dictionary-style features. Authentication is typically via API key; free-tier limits and rate limits should be verified from the current official docs and pricing page before production use.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup on developer portal).

example.response_snippet: [{"text":"a thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule","partOfSpeech":"noun","sourceDictionary":"..."}]

use_cases: look up definitions for an English word
fetch example sentences for a word
